Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
Hello,

I was thinking that I should edit the subdivision (state) list of some countries to reduce the amount of subdivisions in the search by state functions. E.g. United Kingdom has 231 subdivision units, which makes the search by subdivision rather useless. Here are some of the countries that might have some issues with the large amount of subdivisions:

United Kingdom (231 subdivisions)
Macedonia, FYRO (84 subdivisions, no players atm)
Thailand (77 subdivisions)
Malta (68 subdivisions, no players atm)

There are probably others too. I'll list on a following post the amount of subdivisions of each country, so that everyone can tell their opinion on other countries with high amount of subdivisions.

Here are few alternatives that could be used for each country in question:

United Kingdom

Option 1
Regions of England (9)
Northern Ireland (1)
Scotland (1)
Wales (1)
= 12

Option 2
Counties of England (48)
Counties of Northern Ireland (6)
Regions of Scotland (12)
Counties of Wales (8)
= 74

Option 3
Metropolitan and non-metropolitan counties of England (83)
Districts of Northern Ireland (26)
Council Areas of Scotland (32)
Unitary Authorities of Wales (22)
= 163

Option 4 (Current ISO 3166-2:GB)
England (151)
Northern Ireland (26)
Scotland (32)
Wales (22)
= 231

ISO 3166-2:GB

Regions of England
Counties of England
Metropolitan and non-metropolitan counties of England

Counties of Northern Ireland
Local government in Northern Ireland

Subdivisions of Scotland
Regions and islands areas

Preserved counties of Wales
Local government in Wales

Macedonia
Current: 84 municipalities (out of which 10 constitute Greater Skopje)
Option: 8 Statistical Regions of Macedonia

Municipalities of the Republic of Macedonia
Statistical Regions of Macedonia

Thailand
Current: 75 provinces and 2 special administrative regions
Option: 6 regions and Bangkok (total 7)

Provinces of Thailand

Malta
Current: 68 local councils
Option: 6 districts

Local councils of Malta
Districts of Malta

Jussi Hattara
Webmaster Extraordinaire
Finnish  Politics!

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
This is what I found from the BBC site:  BBC - Select your local site

The option 1 is based on the  Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics . Options 2 and 3 are what I scrounged on the Wikipedia site.

The main points in here would be to divide the country into meaningful sized regions, that would be preferably immediately recognizable to local population, and be verifiable by non-local population. Dividing to countries would probably serve the recognition purpose, but they would probably be geographically too large for locating events and stuff.

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
Brazil isn't among those that I would see as a problem.

The point in here is to reduce the amount of subdivisions in areas, where the amount of subdivisions is extremely high compared to the surface area of the country.

United Kingdom: 231 subdivisions, 245,610km2 == 1055 km2/subdiv.
Thailand: 77 subdivisions, 513,120 km2 == 6664 km2/subdiv.
France: 37 subdivisions, 22 in Metropolitan France, 551,695 km2 == 25,100 km2/subdiv.
USA: 57 subdivisions, 9.8 million km2 == 172,000 km2/subdiv.
Russian Federation: 83 subdivisions, 17 million km2 == 205,000 km2/subdiv
Brazil: 27 subdivisions, 8.5 million km2 == 315,000 km2/subdiv.

Do you see the point with UK and Thailand? And also why e.g. France and Brasil do not need the reduction, but countries like UK and Thailand would need the reduction.

Jussi Hattara
